blurb: Mortalis Brewing operates multiple taproom locations including Avon, Buffalo, and Rochester. Guests can enjoy a variety of craft beers on draft, food menus, and seasonal outdoor seating. They also host private events and special celebrations such as their 8th anniversary party.
extraNote: Beer shipping only to limited states; NY, OH, OR, PA currently · No growler fills or personal growler fills; own cans and bottles available · Outdoor seating seasonal, not open late fall to early spring · VIP tickets limited to 50 guests, max 2 tickets per person, non-transferable
